verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for an AI assistant/API service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a region or residency choice. The closest items are project-level controls (budgets, rate limits, IP whitelist), which are adjacent features and earn no credit. The separate international platform with server api.moonshot.ai is a platform fact, not a user-selectable residency option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
